en:
Canned tuna... Now that I'm thinking 
about it, I wanna eat some...

It doesn't even have to be good tuna!
I'm fine with some dolphin mixed in!
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Himiko for a while?

Then let's go look for some cans of tuna in the
dining hall! I'll give you hints with my magic!

<CLT=cltMIND>We ended up talking and eating fish chips
we found in the warehouse.
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko and I grew a little closer today.
